name: LRC Editor
tagline: Create and edit synced lyrics files with ease
description:
LRC Editor helps you create and edit .lrc lyric files, the small text files that sync song lyrics to the music as it plays. Instead of hand-editing timestamps in a text file on a computer, you can do it right on your phone.

It's a handy, focused tool for music fans and lyric contributors who want their favorite songs to show synced lyrics.
